text: To prohibit parking at all times on the south side of McNicoll Avenue, between Warden Avenue and Innislawn Road.

City Council on July 23, 24, 25, 26, 27 and 30, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the south side of McNicoll Avenue, between Warden Avenue and a point 75 metres east. 2. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the south side of McNicoll Avenue, between Innislawn Road and a point 75 metres west.
